newsitem.title: LATVIA: CAUTIOUS OPTIMISM AS SECONDARY LIST SHARES GAIN.
newsitem.headline: CAUTIOUS OPTIMISM AS SECONDARY LIST SHARES GAIN.

text.p: * Secondary list shares extended their recent modest gains on Thursday while three of the five official list stocks eased.
* Overall market volume was 65,000 lats compared to 71,000 lats on Wednesday.
* The Rietumu index inched up 0.61 percent to 192.70.
* Valmiera Glassfibre bounced back after falling steeply on Wednesday, rising to 1.57 lats from 1.37 lats in trade of 6,400 lats.
